question: Do publicly licensed ForecastBench question and resolution files support a deterministic non-personal join on (source,id), with nonzero resolved labels, without inferring per-person exposure?
data: forecastingresearch/forecastbench-datasets public main, historical 2024-07-21 human question set and corresponding resolution set; GitHub connector
test: Read two JSON files; compute counts, duplicate composite keys, matching keys, resolved labels and inconsistent IDs. No person-level forecast data.
strong_control: negative test by joining on synthetic nonexistent source; assert zero matches
success: schema consistent, positive overlap and >=1 resolved label; otherwise FAIL
interpretation: Data engineering feasibility only; cannot prove novel opportunity adjustment or causal leaderboard effect
budget: One phase I AB-R cycle only if A-J execution complete; no phase II started
ethics: No individual human forecast files or real-politician scoring
R5: Stop if data files unavailable or schema not reliable
